$schema.description: Path or URL of this JSON schema

outputDir.description: The root directory where files are generated

language.description: The language of the project (e.g. javascript, react-typescript). Languages are provided by plugins

defaultStructureItem.description: Default options for each structure item

blueprints.description: Paths of the custom blueprints directories (relative to the project)

builders.description: Paths of the custom builders directories (relative to the project)

caseFormatConfig.description: Case format of the generated names, for all of them or for each kind (name, file, folder)

extensions.description: Extension of the generated files, for all of them or for the files and the indexes

structure.description: The folders of the project, by name

oneOf.description: The type of the items generated in this folder

type.description: The type of the items generated in this folder (e.g. component, page)

generateIndex.description: Generate an index file in this folder

generateSubdirs.description: Generate a folder for each generated item

generateSubIndex.description: Generate an index file in the subdirectories

preserveAcronyms.description: Keep the words written in uppercase (e.g. API, HTTP) as they are in camel and pascal case

language.description: The language of this folder, overrides the project language

blueprint.description: The type of another structure item, or a path to a blueprint file

builder.description: The type of another structure item, or a path to a builder file
